title: Wilke volunteer: L4-L5 IDP sitting in an armchair (with backrest)
condition: sitting in an armchair, various postures

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute in vivo intradiscal pressure in the nucleus (MPa), peak/plateau value for the posture

source.authors: Wilke HJ, Neef P, Hinz B, Seidel H, Claes L
source.sample: 1 subject (male volunteer); 1 healthy male volunteer (orthopaedist), non-degenerated L4-L5 disc; telemetric piezoresistive transducer (1.5 mm) in the nucleus; original measurements Wilke et al. 1999 Spine 24:755

protocol.summary: Single healthy male volunteer, telemetric pressure transducer in L4-L5 nucleus, ~24 h recording at 300 Hz; postures/exercises self-performed; values are the peak or plateau of the recorded pressure curve.
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to the subject in protocol.subject_model (sex, age, height, body mass; see weight_which_applies)
Posture: Sit in an armchair with backrest; posture per data[].x
Output: L4-L5 disc compression F (axial, along the disc-normal / upper-vertebra axis) and L4-L5 intersegmental flexion th relative to upright standing
Convert with Ghezelbash 2016 BMMB Eq. 6: P = F / A with A = 1800 mm2 (Wilke 2001); IDP = Eq. 6(P, th) (see protocol.notes); compare with data[].mean

subject_model.height_source: 174 cm (Wilke 1999 / V05 Table 2; Wilke 2001 Appendix A measured 173.9 cm about 2.5 yr later). Wilke 2001 Appendix A 'Body height 173.9 cm' (measured by the authors ~2.5 yr after the IDP study); Wilke 1999 self-reported ~174 cm (Dreischarf 2016 V05 Table 2: 174 cm)
subject_model.weight_source: Wilke 2001 p.S119 (Discussion): 'His weight was 70 kg when we performed the measurements and 72 kg when we took the anthropometric data' (anthropometry ~2.5 yr after the IDP study, p.S117 Sec 3.2: 'body mass amounted to 72 kg', Soehnle scale +/-0.15 kg). 70 kg also in Wilke 1999, Rohlmann 2001 Ergonomics p.784 and V05 Table 2.
subject_model.weight_which_applies: 70 kg is the mass during the IDP measurements (the condition simulated here; self-reported). 72 kg is the measured anthropometric mass 2.5 yr later; the authors call the 2001 measured data 'probably more reliable' and say his weight 'stayed almost constant'. Ghezelbash 2016 (U01 Fig 5 caption), Bruno 2015 Table 3 and the user's targets_msk.json (subjects.wilke.weight_kg) use 72 kg. Recommended: simulate with 72 kg (measured, consistent with the anthropometric data set) and report the 70 kg variant as sensitivity (3% difference).
subject_model.disc_area_source: Wilke 2001 p.S112 Sec 2.2 and p.S119: L4-5 disc area 18 cm2 from the mid-horizontal MRI scan taken 4 weeks before the IDP measurements (same in Rohlmann 2001 Ergonomics p.784 '1800 mm2' and V05 Table 2 '18.0 cm2'). Wilke 2001 also gives anthropometric predictions 19.36 cm2 (from body mass) and 23.97 cm2 (from stature and joint diameters) - not used.
subject_model.other: Full anthropometry (trunk segments standing/sitting, 60+ body dimensions, skinfolds) in Wilke 2001 Tables 1-2 and Appendix A; 50th-percentile German male (45-49 y), active body mass 63.5 kg, fat 8.5 kg (p.S119).
subject_model.level: L4-L5 (transducer in the centre of the non-degenerated L4-5 nucleus)

protocol.idp_conversion: IDP = -1.556e-2 + 1.255 P + 1.243e-2 th + 3.988e-2 P^2 - 1.212e-2 P th + 1.669e-3 th^2 (MPa), P = F_compression / A_disc (MPa = N/mm2), th = L4-L5 intersegmental flexion from upright standing (deg, + flexion). Source: Ghezelbash et al. 2016 Biomech Model Mechanobiol 15:1699, Eq. 6 (U01 p.10; quadratic fit to the Shirazi-Adl 2006 L4-L5 FE model, R2 0.999, RMSE 0.025 MPa; derived with that model's disc area 1455 mm2, applied with the subject's own area); used again as Eq. 1-2 in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 and in the user's MSK validation (MSK_VALIDATION.md 'idp_relation'). Sensitivity alternative: classical Nachemson factor IDP = F / (0.66 A) (Bruno et al. 2015 J Biomech Eng Eq. 2; Dreischarf 2016 V05 uses F = 0.66 IDP A).

data.x: relaxed erect sitting leaning back ~15 deg against the backrest
slouched sitting, stretched legs supported on a stool
slouched sitting, arms across the chest
data.note: value inferred from 'A similar increase was found' (relative to 0.38 of Fig 6c)

data.x: relaxed almost upright sitting without backrest
standing up from the chair / sitting down (peak)
body lifting by the arm supports

extraction.check_notes: Re-read p.S117. 'Arms across the chest' row is stated only as 'a similar increase' to 0.38 MPa - marked in the row note.

pass_rule.rule: pass if |model - measured| <= max(SD or half-range, 0.26 x measured); pooled over all L4-L5 tasks R2 >= 0.78 with slope 95% CI containing 1 and intercept CI containing 0
pass_rule.source: targets_msk.json tolerance_policy.idp_task / idp_aggregate (CV_pool 0.26 = pooled between-subject CV of Sato 1999's 8 healthy subjects)
